project_name: Scayl SaaS Multi-Tenant Admin Panel & Platform Admin Area
design_archetype: Swiss & Technical Precision (Neutral SaaS Control Panel)

identity_strategy.theme_separation_note: The Scayl Admin Panel MUST have a completely neutral, high-contrast Slate/Zinc brand identity (#0F172A / #4F46E5 / #F8FAFC), strictly distinct and visually isolated from any tenant storefront customization (such as the Hapster Cookies teal theme).
identity_strategy.target_users: Store Owners (Lojistas), Store Admins, Product Editors, and Scayl Platform Internal Admins
identity_strategy.tone: Professional, efficient, trustworthy, fast, modular, command-center precision

size_hierarchy.h1_hero_dashboard: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
size_hierarchy.h2_section_title: text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
size_hierarchy.metric_value: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-50 font-mono

layout_and_navigation.structure: Collapsible Sidebar + Fixed Topbar + Main Scrollable Canvas
layout_and_navigation.tenant_workspace_indicator: Active Store Switcher at top of sidebar showing Store Avatar, Store Name ('Hapster Cookies'), Tenant ID badge, and live Store Public View link shortcut
topbar_elements: Store catalog quick preview toggle button (Open store in new tab)
User profile avatar & quick options menu (Logout, Account, Platform Admin Switch)

key_pages_and_features.auth_screens: Clean email/password JWT login, store onboarding step-by-step wizard, role selection simulator for quick demo testing.

kpi_cards: Cliques para finalizar no WhatsApp (Checkout conversion clicks)
Produtos ativos (Active listed items vs catalog limit)
widgets: Interactive conversion funnel line/bar chart with period toggle (Hoje, 7 dias, 30 dias)
Onboarding checklist card (Completar dados, cadastrar 3 produtos, configurar frete, publicar catálogo)

key_pages_and_features.produtos: Data table with photo thumbnail, product name, category badge, price in BRL (R$), availability toggle, active status, views count, search bar, category filter, bulk actions bar (Ativar, Desativar, Excluir), and Create/Edit slide-over drawer featuring multi-image upload drag&drop, price/promo inputs, variations/options manager (tamanhos, sabore), and custom specs.
key_pages_and_features.categorias: Category manager list with drag-and-drop reordering, active status toggle, product count badge, and add/edit category modal.
key_pages_and_features.promocoes_e_cupons: Discount codes grid with coupon code generator, usage limit counter, expiration date selector, discount type (% or R$), min order value, and toggle status.
key_pages_and_features.minha_loja: Store info form: logo upload, store title, description, custom domain / subdomain slug input, WhatsApp contact number with direct click test button, opening hours scheduler.
key_pages_and_features.aparencia_e_banners: Interactive theme customization page with live split preview frame (desktop & mobile preview switchers). Controls for hero banner upload, primary store theme color (overrides public catalog teal), product card style, and header layout.
key_pages_and_features.entrega_e_retirada: Delivery parameters form with options for Local Pickup (Retirada no balcão), Fixed rate delivery zones, distance-based pricing notice, estimated time, and minimum order amount.
key_pages_and_features.formas_de_pagamento: Payment methods toggle panel for PIX (with key setup + QR preview), Cartão na entrega, Dinheiro (com opção de troco), and Pagamento Online integration options.
key_pages_and_features.metricas: Full analytics suite with custom date picker (Range), top viewed products table, traffic channel breakdown, conversion rate indicators, and PDF report export button.
key_pages_and_features.compartilhar_catalogo: Store sharing portal with direct WhatsApp copy link, downloadable QR Code (PNG/SVG), embedded catalog widget iframe code snippet, and social sharing links.
key_pages_and_features.usuarios: Team members list with invitations, email address, role selector (Proprietário, Administrador, Editor de produtos), status (Ativo, Pendente), and permission matrix viewer.
key_pages_and_features.plano_e_assinatura: Subscription manager displaying current active plan (e.g. Plano Pro Scayl), monthly/annual billing cycle, product limit progress bar (85/100 produtos cadastrados), upgrade modal trigger, and invoice billing history table.
key_pages_and_features.configuracoes: Store settings containing notification preferences, webhook integration triggers, catalog auto-closing toggle, and danger zone for store suspension.
key_pages_and_features.admin_scayl_console: Dedicated platform administration area under /admin with MRR metrics, total stores count, store suspension/lock modal, tenant plan override controls, and global system health indicators.

image_urls.description: Bakery product display case showcasing fresh cookies and treats for Hapster Cookies store demo
Assorted gourmet cookies batch photo for product catalog list
Homemade cookies in glass jar for premium specialty item photo
Cozy bakery storefront interior for store profile banner background

data_testid_strategy.rule: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, search, tables, toggles, modals, action triggers) MUST carry explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete functional SaaS merchant panel and /admin Scayl platform area inside JS files.
Maintain high visual distinction between the neutral Slate Scayl Admin Panel and the store owner's live preview catalog.
Use Lucide icons, Sonner for toast notifications, and Shadcn UI components where appropriate.
Ensure every form (Product create/edit, Store settings, Delivery setup, User invites) has full working interactive state with realistic Portuguese text and mock data updates.
Include role-based view permissions switching so users can easily switch between Proprietário, Editor, and Admin Scayl views in demo mode.
